questions.question: How does AJAX improve user experience compared to traditional web applications? (4 X 5 = 20 Marks)
questions.solution_html:
• List and briefly explain the advantages of using AJAX in web applications.
  • What is AJAX?
  • AJAX (Asynchronous JavaScript and XML) is a technique that allows web pages to communicate
  • with a server and update content without reloading the entire page.
  • Advantages
  • Asynchronous Communication: Data is sent and received in the background without interrupting
  • the user's interaction with the page.
  • Reduced Server Load: Only the required data is fetched instead of reloading the entire page
  • reducing bandwidth and server usage.
  • Faster User Experience: The page feels faster because only parts of it are updated, not the whole
  • page.
  • Improved Interactivity: Features like live search suggestions, auto-complete, and real-time
  • updates are possible.
  • Platform Independence: Works with any server-side language (PHP, Python, Java) and any
  • modern browser.
  • Partial Page Update: Only specific sections are updated, preserving the rest of the page layout.
  • Mark Allocation

  • Any 4 advantages clearly explained 4 Marks

questions.question: Describe the purpose and working of different web protocols.
questions.solution_html:
• Introduction
  • A web protocol is a set of rules that defines how data is transmitted and received over the internet.
  • Protocols ensure reliable communication between different devices and systems.
  • DNS – Domain Name System
  • Purpose: Translates human-readable domain names into IP addresses.
  • Port: 53
  • Working: When you type www.google.com, a DNS query is sent to a DNS resolver, which finds
  • the corresponding IP address (e.g., 142.250.195.46) and returns it to the browser.
  • Common DNS Records: A (IPv4 address), AAAA (IPv6), MX (mail server), CNAME (alias).
  • replace() and replaceAll()
  • replace() replaces the first occurrence of a substring. replaceAll() replaces all occurrences.
  • let str = 'Hello World';
  • console.log(str.replace('World', 'MGU')); // Hello MGU
  • let s = 'aabbaa';
  • console.log(s.replaceAll('a', 'x')); // xxbbxx
